research.notes: Intake: the page never says when applications are taken, so unknown. Funding: "Our repayable funding is interest-free and unsecured" for expansions and new businesses; the separate "interest-free contribution to cover up to 75% of the costs" for training, marketing and similar activities does not say whether it is repaid, so it is not listed as a type and its 75% is left out of cost_share (the 50% is the capital share the page gives for repayable funding). No dollar maximum is stated. Location: the program is for businesses in Atlantic Canada, so every NL community meets it. No structure, size or purpose rule: the page states none that a profile can check, and "expansion" does not map to our purposes. The non-profit stream is for organizations that support SMEs, not for a business applying for itself, and is left out. Contacts: the Business Information Services line is on the program page; the NL line is from ACOA's own contact page (second source). The Application for financial assistance is a form and was not read.
